payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Planning: I (Lawanna) am strongest in ui-ux-design, reasonable costs for ISSUE-0001 (review/docs/triage) and higher costs if I take implement/test. I will likely claim one of ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage to avoid overlap. Please coordinate so others take remaining ISSUE-0001 steps or skip, and avoid data-science tasks (my costs are extremely high).

I propose: I take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 1.09). Others (if able) can take ISSUE-0001::implement/docs/triage/test, or split review/docs/triage as needed to maximize covered tasks without duplicates. Please confirm before assignment in execution.

Emil planning: My strongest tag is ui-ux-design; lowest costs on ISSUE-0001 (review/docs/triage all 1.28; implement 2.56; test 1.79). I can take one of ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage to avoid overlap if Lawanna takes review. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 due to high effort/cost.

Raymond planning: My top skills are data-science and documentation. For feasibility with low cost, I can take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.29) or ISSUE-0002::test (6.01), but ISSUE-0002::implement is too costly (8.59, high effort). For ISSUE-0001, all ui-ux tasks have very high cost for me (>=10). To avoid duplicates and maximize total tasks, I suggest taking ISSUE-0002::review while Lawanna/Emil cover ISSUE-0001 steps.

Proposed allocation (planning, not yet committing): Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::review. Please ensure no other agent claims ISSUE-0002::review. Others: Lawanna/Emil handle ISSUE-0001 ui-ux-design micro-tasks; decide implement/docs/triage/test splits to maximize coverage.

Lamont planning: My best fit is data-science/documentation, but I have very high costs for all ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks (>=10) and too-low availability for ISSUE-0002 (review=4.04 exceeds 4.0 slightly). I will likely SKIP unless you want me to take ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage despite high cost. Please confirm allocations so I avoid duplicates and infeasible claims.

Frida planning: strong ui-ux-design, low cost for ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (0.96 each). I should avoid ISSUE-0001 implement (1.93) and all ISSUE-0002 (very costly). To avoid duplicates with Lawanna/Emil, I’m proposing to take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage (whichever is unclaimed). Confirm in execution; planning only for now.

Frida planning question: if Lawanna takes ISSUE-0001::review, should I take ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage (both high priority, same cost 0.96)? Please coordinate to maximize distinct ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks without overlap.

Hipolito planning (avail 5h, skills docs/ui-ux): I can take one ISSUE-0001 ui-ux micro-task with cost 1.36 (review/docs/triage) but I should avoid duplicates with Lawanna/Frida/Emil. I will not take ISSUE-0002 (very high cost) nor ISSUE-0001 implement/test due to higher cost/effort. Please confirm which of ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage is still free if review is taken by Lawanna.

Lawanna planning update: I intend to take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (cost 1.09). Please coordinate so no one else claims ISSUE-0001::review. Feasible next for others: ISSUE-0001::docs and ::triage (both high priority) plus ::implement and ::test as available; I will avoid those due to higher cost.

Emil planning: since Lawanna likely takes ISSUE-0001::review and others may take docs/triage, I will target ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.28) *or* switch to ISSUE-0001::docs if triage is taken. I will skip all ISSUE-0002 tasks due to high cost.

Raymond planning (iter=1): I will target ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.29, high priority). Please ensure no other agent claims ISSUE-0002::review. I will avoid ISSUE-0002::test/implement due to high cost/effort; for ISSUE-0001 ui-ux tasks my costs are too high, so focus on ISSUE-0002 review only.
Raymond coordination: Do not assign ISSUE-0002::review to anyone else; I plan to take it in execution to maximize total tasks without duplicates.

Lamont planning update: Given my costs for ISSUE-0001 are very high (>=10) and ISSUE-0002::review effort slightly exceeds my 4.0 availability, I will likely SKIP ISSUE-0002 unless you need coverage. Emil says he will take ISSUE-0001::triage or ::docs; Lawanna takes ::review. Please confirm ISSUE-0001::triage/docs are claimed so I avoid duplicates, and whether any unclaimed high-priority ui-ux micro-task remains that I could take without overlap.

Frida (planning): I’m prepared to take ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage. Since Lawanna intends ISSUE-0001::review, I’ll avoid duplicate. Please confirm in execution which of ::docs vs ::triage Emil/others are taking so I can take the remaining one; I will avoid ISSUE-0002 entirely due to cost/effort.

Hipolito planning: Lawanna intends ISSUE-0001::review; I can take either ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.36) or ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.36) if unclaimed. Please confirm Emil/Frida not taking those so we maximize distinct ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks without duplicates. I will skip all ISSUE-0002.

Lawanna planning (phase planning, iter 1): I will claim ISSUE-0001::review in execution (cost 1.09). Please ensure ISSUE-0001::review is unique. For remaining ui-ux micro-tasks, coordinate among Emil/Frida/Hipolito to avoid duplicates: target splitting {docs, triage} at most two agents, skip implement/test if overlaps likely. Avoid all ISSUE-0002 due to infeasible/high cost for me.

Emil planning update: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (cost 1.28) to complement Lawanna’s likely ISSUE-0001::review. If triage is taken by someone else first, I will take ISSUE-0001::docs; I will skip all ISSUE-0002 tasks.
Raymond planning: will take ISSUE-0002::review in execution. Please do NOT assign ISSUE-0002::review to anyone else. For ISSUE-0001, I’m keeping clear of ui-ux tasks due to high cost (>=10 for me).

Also confirming: I will not take ISSUE-0002::test or ::implement (too costly/effort). Please cover remaining ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks among Lawanna/Emil/Frida/Hipolito without duplication (e.g., review by Lawanna, triage/docs split).

Lamont planning to skip unless an unclaimed ISSUE-0001 micro-task (docs/triage) is left that no one else takes; my costs for ISSUE-0001 are very high (>=10) and ISSUE-0002::review is slightly infeasible (effort 4.0 vs availability 4.0). Please confirm final intended unique picks for ISSUE-0001::docs and ::triage and whether ISSUE-0002::review must be covered.

Frida planning: Since Lawanna will take ISSUE-0001::review and Emil likely takes ::triage, I propose Frida take the remaining ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 0.96, effort 1.0) in execution. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks and will avoid implement/test to prevent cost/overlap. Please confirm docs is unclaimed.

Hipolito planning: Lawanna intends ISSUE-0001::review; Raymond intends ISSUE-0002::review; others likely take ISSUE-0001::triage and/or ::docs. I can take exactly one of ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage if unclaimed. Please confirm whether ::docs or ::triage is still free before execution so we avoid duplicates; I will not take implement/test or any ISSUE-0002.

Planning coordination: I (Lawanna) will take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (unique). To maximize distinct high-priority coverage, others should take ISSUE-0001::docs and ISSUE-0001::triage, while avoiding implement/test to prevent my high costs. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Emil planning (phase planning, iter1): I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::docs. I will skip all ISSUE-0002 tasks to avoid infeasible/high cost. Reminder: Lawanna takes ISSUE-0001::review; Raymond takes ISSUE-0002::review; aim is unique picks: review + triage + docs.

Raymond planning update (executing soon): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (effort 4.0, high priority). Please ensure no other agent claims ISSUE-0002::review. I will not take ISSUE-0002::implement or ::test.

Lamont planning check: I will SKIP all ISSUE-0001 tasks (very high cost) and will only take ISSUE-0002::review if it is not already claimed and if we accept feasibility risk (effort 4.0 vs availability 4.0, cost 4.04). Please confirm who will take ISSUE-0002::review so I avoid duplicates/infeasible claims.

Frida planning: I will take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 1.0, cost 0.96) in execution if unclaimed; will not take review/triage/implement/test or any ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please confirm Emil/Hipolito are not taking docs to avoid duplicates; otherwise I can switch to ISSUE-0001::triage only if docs is taken by someone else.

Hipolito planning: I will take exactly one of ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (cost 1.36 each). Since Lawanna intends ISSUE-0001::review and Raymond intends ISSUE-0002::review, I’m asking for confirmation which of ::docs vs ::triage remains unclaimed by Emil/Frida so we avoid duplicates. I will skip all ISSUE-0002 tasks and will not take implement/test.
